verdict.rationale: Headless or CI execution is a fair question for an AI assistant, but the evidence describes only interactive surfaces: chat, Office app integrations, connectors on Copilot.com and mobile, and in-browser actions that the user watches in real time. Nothing documents a CLI, API, or non-interactive mode for automation pipelines, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Generic claims about automating repetitive tasks describe interactive use, not headless execution, so they earn no credit.
